admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Models, credentials, integrations, users, and API tokens. Admin-only.

models.intro: Configure the LLM / embedding model used for each task. Every server (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM …) exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1 API — no provider selector needed. Leave the API key blank to keep the stored secret.
models.maxPromptTokensHint: Optional. Prompt-token limit for this model. Leave empty to use the default. On large repos the code is split into chunks that each fit this limit.

git.intro: Add one or more accounts per provider. Each account pairs a URL (leave blank for the public cloud) with an access token; the right token is chosen automatically by matching the repository host. The public github.com / gitlab.com can coexist with a self-hosted instance on another host.
git.accountsHint: Leave a URL blank for public GitHub / GitLab. Add separate rows for self-hosted instances.

ssl.intro: TLS configuration for reaching an HTTPS LLM/embedder gateway (e.g. a corporate AI gateway) whose certificate is signed by an internal CA. Either point every client at your corporate root cert (recommended), or disable verification (insecure fallback). Local HTTP LLM servers are unaffected.
ssl.caBundleHint: Filesystem path to a .pem/.crt with your corporate root CA. Export it from the OS keychain if needed.
ssl.verifyHint: ON = trust the CA bundle above (or the default store). OFF = skip verification — insecure, MITM risk. Only use when no CA file is available.
ssl.warningOff: Verification is OFF. Connections are vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.

integrations.intro: HTTP integrations: templated GET endpoints exposed to agents as named tools. Declare {placeholders} in the URL template; the agent fills them per product when calling the tool.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.secretsHint: Header values are stored encrypted and shown masked. Type new key=value lines to replace them; leave empty to keep the stored values.

mcp.intro: Global registry of external MCP servers (HTTP / stdio). Bind them per product to extend the expert agent with their tools. Inbound MCP access is served at /api/mcp with an API token.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.deleteConfirm: Delete this MCP server? Product bindings are detached automatically.
mcp.secretsHint: Header and env values are stored encrypted and shown masked. Type new key=value lines to replace them; leave empty to keep the stored values.
mcp.toggleLabel: Enable or disable this MCP server

prompts.intro: Edit the markdown prompt templates (refs/prompts/ru and refs/prompts/en) on the fly — changes take effect on the next generation run. When a translation is missing, the English original is shown; saving creates the copy in the selected language.
prompts.languageHint: The language documentation is generated in. Applies on the next generation run; the prompts of that language are edited below.

publicapi.intro: The current public OpenAPI schema of the Productarium API (read-only).

embedder.title: Embedder rate limits
embedder.subtitle: Throttles /v1/embeddings calls used by the pgvector memory backend during indexing.
embedder.intro: Configure rate limits and concurrency for the embedder (pgvector memory).
embedder.hint: Throttles /v1/embeddings calls during chunking and pgvector indexing. Lower concurrency if the embedding provider returns 429 errors.

memory.intro: Agent memory: the pgvector direct store (Postgres + HNSW cosine recall).
memory.backendSub: Selects where indexed product knowledge is stored and recalled from.
memory.pgvectorDesc: Direct Postgres+pgvector chunk store with HNSW cosine recall (fast, no graph extraction).
memory.statusSub: Live availability + indexed volume for the active backend.
memory.reindexSub: Rebuild the index from source artifacts (codebases, specs, links, knowledge nodes). Leave the product id blank to reindex all products.

timeouts.intro: Centralized timeout management. Each value is resolved with precedence: admin store > env var > default. Leave a field empty to fall back to the env var or the built-in default.

hints.llm_retry_max_time: Backoff retry budget for transient LLM errors.
hints.model_list: HTTP timeout for model listing and existence checks.
hints.provider_test: Timeout for the admin panel connection test.
hints.docgen_map_concurrency: Max parallel LLM calls in the docgen MAP phase; 1 = strictly sequential.
hints.expert_stream: Budget for one expert ask. The turn runs as a detached background task and survives client disconnects, so minutes are normal; on expiry the partial answer is saved.
hints.docgen_indexing_drain: How long a docgen worker waits for background memory indexing before finishing the job.
hints.memory_query: pgvector cosine-recall query timeout (embed query + ORDER BY embedding <=> :q LIMIT k). On timeout the backend returns an empty string and the expert falls back to artifact docs.
hints.git_file_content: HTTP timeout for GitHub/GitLab file-content API fetches.
hints.mcp_stdio_wait: Timeout for .wait() on the MCP stdio subprocess.
hints.mermaid_verify: Per-diagram verification timeout via the Node validator.
hints.mermaid_repair: Per-LLM-call timeout for repairing one diagram.
hints.mermaid_max_repair_attempts: Repair attempt budget per unique diagram body.
hints.mermaid_repair_deadline: Wall-clock budget for the whole repair drain of one page.
hints.db_connect_check: Budget for the full MCP handshake when adding a preset database (launcher spawn + initialize + tools/list + one probe tool call). Generous default — the docker-fallback launcher may pull the image on the very first check.
